hero.title: Your measurements, in about a minute.
hero.description: Prop your phone up, step back and follow the voice. Qlozet takes a front and a side view by itself and turns them into the measurements a tailor needs.

ways.title: Pick the way that suits you
ways.description: A body scan is the most accurate. If you'd rather not scan, there's always another way, and you can change any number afterwards.
points: Body scan: about a minute, hands-free
Two photos: someone can take them for you
Quick estimate: your height, weight and a few questions about your shape
Your own numbers: type them in, or snap your tailor's book

privacy.title: Only an outline leaves your phone
privacy.description: Your phone turns each picture into a plain outline of your body. That outline is all we receive. It's measured, then discarded.
points: No photo of you is uploaded
Your measurements stay yours to edit or delete

result.title: Review it, then make it yours
result.description: Your measurements arrive as a list you can check. Change any number that seems off, then save the set for your orders.
points: Edit any number before you save
Make it your default with one switch

order.title: Nothing missing when you order
order.description: Each outfit knows which measurements it needs. Pick a saved set at checkout and we check it has them all before you pay.
points: Your measurements travel with every made-to-measure order
Missing numbers are flagged before you pay
Your tailor works from the numbers you approved

closing.title: Measure once. Order made to measure.
closing.description: Join the waitlist to be among the first to try the hands-free scan.
